neet_phy_u07_t00_3.working: A large plastic region between elastic limit and fracture means ductile, so P is ductile. Fracture just after the elastic limit means brittle, so Q is brittle.

neet_phy_u07_t00_4.working: Stress is force/area, so its unit is N/m², the same as pressure, and A is true. Strain is a ratio of lengths and dimensionless, so R is true. R explains strain, not why stress has the unit of pressure, so it is not the explanation of A.

neet_phy_u07_t00_5.working: Hooke's law holds only up to the proportional limit, so I is false. Rubber is an elastomer with a large elastic region and no well-defined plastic region, so II is false.
